title: Transcendence of continued fractions over function fields and a quantitative version of Uchiyama's theorem
summary: Given a field $K$, let $K((T^{-1}))$ be the field of formal power series. Continued fractions in $K((T^{-1}))$ can be defined by analogy with classical real continued fractions and have been widely studied. Some results establish the transcendence of elements of $K((T^{-1}))$ arising from special families of continued fractions, but much remains to be explored. In this paper, assuming that $K$ has characteristic zero, we improve the known analogues of the Maillet--Baker criteria for quasi-periodic continued fractions.
